query: Which master brake cylinder is listed for a 1985 CASE W20C?
response_text:
The **US/North American CASE W20C catalog covering 1982–1989 lists two master brake cylinders**. The 1985 year alone doesn’t distinguish them:

The catalog directs ordering **N6937** kit for service. key_facts: In the provisional North American W20C catalog covering 01/82–12/89, two brake-actuator master cylinders are listed; the supplied 1985 year alone does not distinguish the installed actuator.

N8695 — master cylinder for the L113007 brake actuator, catalog quantity 1, includes callouts 15–31; no separate cylinder callout is shown. Its description specifies 200 mm stroke. Repair kit N8937 is listed separately. Inspected a166, “7-68 - L113007 BRAKE ACTUATOR” (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l113007-brake-actuator/cn/4D9B6E81-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6); cylinder product https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/hydraulic-cylinder/p/N8695.

N8469 — master cylinder in a165, “7-58 - L107985 AND L112959 BRAKE ACTUATORS,” catalog quantity 1, includes callouts 25–49; no separate cylinder callout or dimensions are shown. The row instructs ordering N6937 kit for service (https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l107985-and-l112959-brake-actuators/cn/53488E5D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6; cylinder product https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/hydraulic-cylinder/p/N8469).

Figure 7-58 says the complete L107985 and L112959 actuators are no longer available and directs ordering L113007. This does not establish that their individual master cylinders interchange. Confirm the installed actuator identification to choose between N8469 and N8695.

Assembly evidence was observed on 2026-11-04; all returned rows of figures 7-36, 7-58 and 7-68 were inspected without truncation. Machine discovery uses a dated partial index, and the assembly sources do not establish catalog-wide completeness or serial-specific fitment.

parent_completions.text:
The **US/North American CASE W20C catalog covering 1982–1989 lists two master brake cylinders**. The 1985 year alone doesn’t distinguish them:

| Installed brake actuator | Listed master cylinder | Catalog details |
|---|---|---|
| **L113007** | **[N8695](url_7)** | Quantity 1; 200 mm stroke; includes callouts 15–31. Repair kit **N8937** is listed separately. [Assembly 7-68](url_6) |
| **L107985 or L112959** | **[N8469](url_4)** | Quantity 1; includes callouts 25–49. The catalog directs ordering **N6937** kit for service. [Assembly 7-58](url_3) |

*The catalog replaces the complete older actuators with L113007; that does not establish interchangeability of the individual master cylinders.*

Can you identify which brake actuator is installed: **L107985, L112959, or L113007**?
